moisture_pct.note: IFCT E055 Pomegranate, maroon seeds 83.55+/-0.39 (edible arils)

water_activity.note: From highest freezing point -3.0 C (Cantwell 2001) via ln aw = -0.00969*dTf (Chirife & Fontan 1982) = 0.971

respiration.note: AH-66 chapter: 4-8 (5 C), 8-16 (10 C), 16-36 (20 C); declines with storage time. Ea fitted by Arrhenius to midpoints

storage_optimum.note: Cantwell 2001: 5-7.2 C, 90-95% RH, 2-3 months. AH-66: 6 C / 90% RH for 'Hicaznar'; RH 90-98% preferred; do not store <5 C (chilling injury: husk scald, pitting, pale arils)

ethylene.note: <0.1 uL/kg.h up to 10 C and <0.2 uL/kg.h at 10-20 C; non-climacteric, not particularly ethylene sensitive (AH-66). Rind desiccates readily at low RH

cut.note: respiration_x = AH-66 fresh-cut arils (2.9-5.9 at 5 C, 5.7-11.4 at 10 C) / whole fruit (4-8, 8-16) midpoint ratios; arils respire less per kg than whole fruit. 4 h = FDA Food Code 3-501.19 time-as-control limit
